preconditions: At least three independently supported observed controls for the same contact
Every control has authorized absolute elevation
The XY affine design matrix [1,x,y] has rank 3
Every control role is DirectSubsurfaceContact; repeated samples of a mapped surface trace do not count as independent subsurface support
Maximum condition number and maximum control residual are explicit project numerical parameters
decisionLogic: Fit the shared RBF surface only after the evidence audit passes.
Evaluate only inside or on the closed convex hull of authorized controls.
Return UNKNOWN outside the hull; never silently extrapolate.

mathematicalChecks.independence: at least three distinct independentSupportId values
mathematicalChecks.domain: convex hull of authorized XY controls
mathematicalChecks.numericalStability: conditionNumber <= declared maximum and max(abs(predicted-observed Z)) <= declared residual tolerance

validationMethod: Inside, boundary, outside, insufficient, collinear, mixed-contact and unauthorized controls
reopenCondition: A source-backed extrapolation or non-graph/overturned surface model is introduced
